artworks.title: Ambrose Dudley, Earl of Warwick
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man facing forward but turned slightly to his right. He has a long beard and styled mustache, with a large, round hat adorned with a feather. He wears a fur garment with a high collar, a patterned coat, and a necklace with a medallion or pendant. The background features an oval frame with text around it, and additional text below the frame.

artworks.title: Ambrose Dudley, Earl of Warwick
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body within an oval frame. The man faces slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. He has distinct facial features, a neatly trimmed beard, mustache, and light hair under a cap with a decorative feather-like element. He wears a detailed garment with a fur-lined high collar and buttons, and below the portrait is a Latin inscription. The background has intricate linework, and the portrait is printed on a slightly aged sheet with yellowing and creases at the edges.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Countess Warwick
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman's bust. She is facing slightly right, with distinct arched eyebrows, long wavy hair, and wearing an off-the-shoulder garment. She has a double-strand pearl necklace. The background is textured paper, and details mention the name "Elisabet Cornelius Warwyck," artist A. van Dyk, and publication in 1791 by W. Richardson. Brown spots are scattered on the aged paper.

artworks.title: Mary Boyle, Countess of Warwick
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman named Elisabeth Comitissa Warwyck. The portrait shows an upper-body view of the woman with her head slightly turned to her left. She has a calm expression with thin eyebrows and slightly parted lips. Her long, wavy hair falls over her shoulders. She is wearing an elegant dress with a broad neckline and a pearl necklace. The portrait is set within an oval medallion in a larger rectangular frame with an intricate decorative pattern. The background of the engraving includes artwork text and the artist's name.

artworks.title: William von Welsberg, Archbishop of Brixen
artworks.description: The engraving features a portrait of a man from the waist up within an elaborate oval frame. He is seated and facing slightly left with a composed expression. The man has a neatly trimmed beard, mustache, and wears a cap. He is dressed in a high-collared cloak, holding a small book in his left hand. Classical elements surround the frame, including cherubs and female figures. The background displays intricate architectural and ornamental designs.

artworks.title: Johannes Angelius Werdenhagen
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting Johann Angelus Werdenhagen. He is shown facing the viewer in the center of an elaborate oval frame. Werdenhagen has a mustache and a pointed beard, with his hair styled back. He wears a richly decorated garment with a high ruff collar adorned with lace patterns. The background features textured patterns, scrolls, inscriptions, and ornate detailing.

artworks.title: William Whitaker, D.D., Master of Saint John's College, Cambridge
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, sitting in a frontal position with his body slightly turned to his left. His hands are holding an open book. He has a rounded face with a full beard and mustache, and his hair is covered by a flat wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a robe with a fur or feather-trimmed collar over a garment with a pleated ruff around his neck. The background is plain with a textured pattern, typical of engraving. Below the portrait, there is an inscription with text.

artworks.title: William Whitaker, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up, sitting and holding a book. He is depicted in a three-quarter view, with a serious expression. The man has a well-defined face with a trimmed beard and mustache, and wears a dark robe with a high collar over a lighter garment. He is also wearing a flat cap and a ruffled collar. In his hands, he holds an open book. The background features an ornate oval frame with text surrounding the portrait. The image is set against a plain paper with visible foxing.

artworks.title: William Whitaker, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved depiction of a man's upper body and head, facing forward slightly to his right. He has a full beard and moustache, with distinct facial features including a straight nose and a somewhat serious expression. The man is wearing a wide, rounded hat and a high-collared, fur-lined cloak over his shoulders. His clothing appears to be indicative of formal or academic wear. The background features lines for shading, typical of engraving techniques. Surrounding the portrait is an oval border with text, and additional Latin text beneath the image. The engraving appears on a textured, aged paper.

artworks.title: Francis White, D.D., Bishop of Ely
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person's upper body in a seated position, with their hands resting on a book and holding a writing quill. They have a composed expression with distinct facial features, including a neatly trimmed beard and short hair. The individual is dressed in classical attire with a ruffled collar and ornate robe. The background includes objects like a globe, books, and a cushion, creating a scholarly atmosphere. Surrounding the person is a decorative border with scroll-like and shield motifs, Latin inscriptions, and banners. A verse inscription is below the portrait, blending into the intricate design.

artworks.title: Francis White, Bishop of Ely
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man seated from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the right, with a mature face, a beard, and combed hair under a cap. He is dressed in elaborate Elizabethan clothing with a ruffled collar and rich decoration, holding an open book. The oval frame surrounding the portrait features scrolls, Latin text, and a coat of arms at the top. The background inside the frame is detailed, and the outer frame includes decorative elements like a skull and books. English text at the bottom is visible, and the composition is set against a plain paper background.

artworks.title: Richard White of Basingstoke, Hampshire
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body in profile, facing to the right. The man is shown with curly hair and a short, stylized beard, detailed facial features, and wearing a richly decorated garment with an elaborate ruffled collar and patterned fabric. The clothing includes ornamental designs, suggestive of a formal and possibly noble status. Surrounding him is an inscribed circular border with Latin script identifying him as "RICARDUS VITUS BASINSTOCHIUS COMES PALATINUS." The background is plain.

artworks.title: David Whitehead, D.D., Chaplain to Anne Boleyn
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man with a white beard and mustache, wearing a cap and a fur collar over a robe. His body is turned slightly to the side, with his head facing the viewer. His hands are partially visible in front of him. The background has a crosshatch pattern. Below the image is a label with the name "DAVIT WHITEHET" and a passage in Latin script.

artworks.title: John Whitgift, D.D., Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his hands resting on a flat surface. He has a serious expression with distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a full beard. He is wearing a textured cap, a high-collared garment that appears to be a cassock, and a cape or cloak. The attire includes an ornate ruff around the neck. In the background, there is a blank textured surface. Text below the image identifies him as "IOHANNES WHITGIFTUS ARCHEP."

artworks.title: Sir Richard Whittington, Lord Mayor of London
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man in an ornately decorated oval frame. He is standing upright with his head turned slightly to the left. He wears a decorative hat, a detailed robe with embroidery and chains, and holds a small, furry animal in his left hand. The background features cross-hatched patterns, ornate designs, and text identifying the subject as Richard Whitington. Surrounding the portrait are additional texts detailing the subject's achievements and importance.

artworks.title: Richard Whittington
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of Richard Whitington from the waist up. He is seated and looking slightly to the right with a dignified expression. Whitington has a long, narrow nose, a firm-set mouth, and aged features. He wears a headscarf, draped fabric, a high collar, and a chain of office. In his left arm, he holds a small cat, and in his right hand, he holds a scroll. The background features an intricately designed frame with inscriptions and heraldic symbols. The portrait oval's border includes Latin text and crests, with a decorative design at the bottom that describes Richard Whitington's accomplishments.

artworks.title: Willem Lodewyk, Count of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the shoulders up, facing slightly towards the right. He has distinct facial features with a strong eyebrow line, broad nose, full beard, and mustache. His hair is short. He is depicted wearing an elaborate outfit with a high ruffled collar and a detailed cloak. The portrait is framed in a circular design against a lined background. Below the image is a rectangular nameplate with the inscription: WILLEM LODEWYK, GRAEF VAN NASSAU, and additional identifying details.

artworks.title: William I of England
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing the viewer with his body slightly angled to the right. The man has an aged face with a beard and mustache, wearing a crown with spherical decorations, and curly hair extending from beneath it. He is dressed in Roman armor with intricate designs on the shoulder piece, holding a sword upwards in his right hand. The background features ornate decorations including a crest with lions and Latin text framing his portrait as well as text below detailing historical achievements and life events. The scene is presented on aged, yellowed paper that appears to be an engraved illustration.

artworks.title: William I in Helmet
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in armor, with detailed engravings and rivets. The subject is turned slightly to the right, wearing a helmet with a plume. They have a bushy mustache and a medallion on the armor. The background is dark with hatching, and the portrait is in an oval frame with text identifying the individual as Wilhelm, a Norman duke and king of England.

artworks.title: William II
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a seated man with long wavy hair wearing royal attire and a crown. He is holding an orb in his left hand and a scepter in his right hand. The background features ornate scroll patterns and heraldic symbols. Banners with text surround the figure. The border includes additional heraldic symbols, and there is a block of text beneath the portrait identifying the man as William Rufus, King of England and Duke of Normandy. The background of the image is a blank canvas.

artworks.title: William I, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a man on a rearing horse, positioned in profile facing left. The man has a beard and mustache, with a tall, flat-brimmed hat that obscures most of his hair. He wears an elaborate outfit with a buttoned coat, a sash, and holds a baton in his right hand, with a sword at his side. In the background, there is a coat of arms at the upper right, flanked by two figures. The landscape below includes a cityscape with buildings and water. At the bottom, there is text framed like a dedication or inscription.

artworks.title: William I, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image depicts a three-quarter portrait of a person from their head down to their waist. The individual is positioned slightly to the side, with their body facing forward and their head turned to the right. They have curly hair and a short beard and mustache. Adorned in ornate armor, the person holds a baton in their left hand. The background features detailed architecture on the left side and a bordered coat of arms on the right side with inscriptions around it. The style suggests a historical or nobility theme with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: William of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.artist: Christoffel van Sichem I after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.6 x 14.2 cm (7 5/16 x 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man standing upright in a dignified pose. He has a beard, mustache, curly hair, a lace-trimmed ruff around his neck, armor, and is holding a baton in his right hand and resting his left hand on the hilt of a sword. A helmet with a feathered plume is on a table next to him. The background shows a battle scene with troops and cavalry. In the bottom right corner, there is a circular diagram with writing.

artworks.title: William of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.artist: Christoffel van Sichem I after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.5 x 12.4 cm (7 11/16 x 4 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a composed posture. He is positioned with one hand resting on the hilt of a sword or staff on a curved surface, while his other hand appears to rest near a helmet and gauntlet on a draped pedestal. The man has a beard, mustache, wavy hair, and wears ornate armor with floral patterns on the shoulder pauldrons and a high ruffled collar. The background is plain with a textured, aged appearance typical of an engraving. The bottom of the image contains inscriptions with text formatted in classical script.
